log: A Tavern welcomes you before The Lucent Depths.

enemies.name: The Refraction Cannon
enemies.signature: Fires three counter-element fields then a destruction field. Every launch also attacks normally for 14. Bullets move two columns left; arrival is 12 Pierce. Covering disables a card. Radius-1 fields restrict activations; destroying the bullet removes its field. At the end of each full move cycle, if afflicted by Burn, Poison or Corrode, spends its next move on Purify to clear all three, then resumes its cycle.
enemies.counter: Kill or work around each moving field. Equipment is the only defense against a bullet that reaches you.
